sloka: पितरो वसवः साध्या ह्यश्विनौ मरुतो मनुः ।वायुर्वह्निः प्रजापाण ऋतुकर्ता प्रभाकरः ।। ६.१०७.९ ।।
transliteration: pitaro vasavaḥ sādhyā hyaśvinau maruto manuḥ ।vāyurvahniḥ prajāpāṇa ṛtukartā prabhākaraḥ ।। 6.107.9 ।।

translations.english: "He is the god of manes, Vasava, Sadhayas, Aswins, Marutha, Manu, wind god, fire god, life of all beings and god of all seasons.
